note: From `_suffixed/source.json`, all in variant `individer`. FAMTYP (var 81, 2019-2020) and FAMTYP_BARNREG (var 82, 2020-2021) share only 2020, FAMTYP's last year and FAMTYP_BARNREG's first: a handover, so the pair is the one fold candidate (the breg FamTyp / Famtyp_BarnReg shape). HID (var 83, 2019-2021) and HID_IoT (var 84, 2020) also share one year, but HID keeps delivering in 2021, so the two were co-delivered and are not proposed (the LISA HushallsID / HushallsID_IoT shape). The two var_ids differ, so the candidate names no shared native variable.
